Walmart Reports Q4 Adj. EPS $1.33 vs $1.37 Est., Sales $136.3B vs $134.9B Est.

WMT_2018q2.summary_analysis: Coverage portrayed the quarter as mixed: earnings beat expectations but sales fell short. The retrieved coverage did not identify a separate guidance change as a major theme. Beyond the headline result, the articles supplied the following operating and market context: Meanwhile, average EPS growth of 23.1 percent is significantly better than the 16.3 percent that CFRA had expected at the start of earnings season. The Atlanta Fed’s GDP Now indicator looks ahead to what GDP might end up being this quarter, and right now it’s projecting very solid 4.1 percent growth. It’s still nearly two weeks until the government issues its second estimate for Q1 gross domestic product (GDP) on May 30, but that doesn’t mean it’s too early to start talking about potential Q2 GDP. The company said in a press release that its overall top-line sales came in below management’s expectations, blaming cold April weather. Penney Company Inc. (NYSE: JCP ) appeared to disappoint investors, who sent shares down more than 11 percent in pre-market futures trading.
WMT_2018q2.why_moved: The stock fell 2.7% over the two-day earnings window. The coverage implies that investors prioritized the negative side of the mixed release, although no article explicitly confirms a single catalyst.

WMT_2018q3.summary_analysis: Coverage focused on the earnings release and its implications: the articles did not provide a consistent beat-or-miss framing. The coverage also emphasized management's outlook, but did not characterize it consistently as a clear positive or negative. Beyond the headline result, the articles supplied the following operating and market context: About 100 basis points of the comparable sales growth of 4.5 percent was contributed by ecommerce, the company said, and that estimate puts ecommerce sales up about 40 percent year-on-year, according to analysts. "E-commerce sales also improved sequentially and rose 40 percent, in line with the company's once controversial full year guidance," Wells Fargo said in its report on the earnings. There was other positive news on the earnings front late Wednesday, when Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ: CSCO ) beat Wall Street analysts’ estimates and raised guidance, citing higher revenue from subscriptions in its software and services business. The company also looked very impressive in raising earnings guidance for the full fiscal year to between $4.90 and $5.05, from previous guidance of $4.75 to $5. 2017), which is expected to offer same-day delivery to about 2/3 of US by year end as both a fulfillment option on Target.com and for a growing list of retail partners (we expect more to be announced in addition to Publix, HEB, Meijer and others). The slumping crude market advanced a bit early Thursday but remains near two-month lows (See Figure 1 below).
WMT_2018q3.why_moved: The stock rose 7.2% over the two-day earnings window. The articles do not isolate a first-order catalyst, so the positive reaction cannot be attributed more precisely from this coverage.
